problem_restatement: Restore the broken BRENTOIL external-candidate evidence lane, then determine whether its exact current evidence supports a V57 live proposal.

defect.symptom: The external opportunity pipeline reported BRENTOIL observer is stale while the active source-revision-recovery observer was fresh.
defect.root_cause: The standalone monitor defaulted to the retired brentoil_oil_shock_shadow_latest.json instead of the active brentoil_oil_shock_shadow_v2_latest.json.
defect.fix: Bind the monitor default to the active v2 status path.
defect.scope: report-only monitor input identity; no strategy, risk, routing, sizing, or live process changed
defect.validation: The new default-path regression failed before the fix; 18 focused tests, Ruff check, Ruff format, an isolated real one-shot publication, and the restarted monitor all passed afterward.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The three historical live-canary lifecycles belong to older BRENTOIL route contracts and do not establish the oil-shock candidate's expectancy.
Development stress is negative and validation and holdout remain unopened.
Historical mark paths are incomplete and public-trade OHLC does not yet match live candleSnapshot OHLC row-for-row.
Only one prospective eligible oil-shock decision exists, so side-specific repeatability is unknown.
The mutable observer will continue advancing; the immutable evidence snapshot freezes only this decision point.

recommendation.1_recommendation: Defer BRENTOIL live addition and continue only passive report-only collection or test a materially different preregistered mechanism.
recommendation.2_why_now: The repaired pipeline can finally evaluate the active source-revision-recovery observer without stale-input contamination.
recommendation.3_evidence_reviewed: Exact live-canary reconciliation, 44/42-trade development nominal/stress results, current v2 observer, candle-source parity artifact, and current V57 runtime identity.
recommendation.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: BRENTOIL is liquid and inexpensive to cross, but the tested oil-shock mechanism loses under stress and its technical price paths remain unresolved.
recommendation.5_applicable_market_regime: Five-minute BRENTOIL oil-shock mean-reversion on the current HIP-3 market; no claim is made outside that mechanism or venue source.
recommendation.6_alternatives: Promote now, retune after seeing current results, continue passive observation, resolve source/path evidence, or preregister a different mechanism. Promotion and post-result tuning are unsupported.
recommendation.8_expected_upside: Avoid consuming portfolio capacity with a stress-negative and technically unresolved transfer while retaining a high-liquidity research lane.
recommendation.9_main_risks: Deferral can miss future profitable shocks; sparse live evidence may not represent future regimes; a different BRENTOIL mechanism could have edge.
recommendation.10_validation_completed: Source-bound evidence loading, identity and authority validation, nominal/stress comparison, live-canary largest-winner sensitivity, parity status, regression test, and real monitor publication.
recommendation.11_validation_still_required: Resolved mark/L2 paths, exact live/archive candle parity, preregistered validation and holdout, realistic mechanism-specific costs, and resolved prospective lifecycles for both configured directions.
recommendation.12_success_metrics: Positive stress after costs, profit factor above one, positive net excluding the largest winner, complete technical paths, exact source parity, and side-specific forward evidence.
recommendation.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: No rollback applies because no live change is proposed. Reopen only after a changed assumption or materially new preregistered evidence satisfies the remaining validation requirements.
recommendation.14_confidence: High confidence that the current candidate is not approval-ready; low confidence about all possible BRENTOIL strategies because only one mechanism is evaluated.

hypothesis_decision.decision_reason: Development stress is negative, source parity and technical paths are unresolved, and the sparse historical live result becomes negative after removing its largest winner.
hypothesis_decision.reopen_condition: A preregistered independent window resolves source and mark paths and remains positive after realistic costs and largest-winner removal, or a materially different mechanism is specified before results.

next_investigation.minimum_evidence_to_update_diagnosis: At least one attributable eligible signal and one fully resolved lifecycle for each configured direction.

claim_falsifiers: The immutable evidence snapshot does not reproduce the reported development, canary, liquidity, parity, or observer values.
A source audit proves the active v2 observer was not the intended source-revision-recovery epoch.
A preregistered exact-source validation becomes positive under stress and remains positive after removing its largest winner.
Complete mark/L2 reconstruction materially changes the current negative stress conclusion.
